verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a 3D rendering and game engine whose ecosystem includes interactive tools (Playground, Inspector, Node Material Editor), so a built-in AI assistant is a fair capability to ask about. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any built-in AI assistant or task delegation in the engine or those tools. The only AI-adjacent items are llms.txt files and a probe confirming there is no official MCP server, and neither amounts to an in-product assistant.
